text:
Tori: Hey team — I submitted my resignation yesterday. My last day will be 2026-04-03. I want to set up a compact handoff next week. Quick Q: when do benefits end and when will COBRA enrollment start?

Ben: Thanks for letting us know, Tori. We'll run the offboard checklist. Benefits cutoff is on your last day (2026-04-03 23:59 PT). COBRA notice email is sent within ~10 business days and enrollment window is 60 days from that notice. I'll DM the specifics and next steps. :+1:

Alexis: Noted. @Tori can you drop a short list of open PRs and any ongoing tickets you want covered? I can take primary on the infra items.

Tori: Open PRs: #432 (model-routing), #478 (batching edge-case). I can pair with you Mon/Tue for final runthrough. Laptop + keycard: plan to drop laptop at HQ mailroom and return keycard on last Friday unless you need me onsite.

Michael: IT here — SSO/API access schedule: we normally revoke SSO at EOD of last day unless you request extended access for shadowing. We will rotate and revoke long-lived API keys at deprovision. If you want any tokens rotated earlier, tell us. Also run this check before your last day to list keys:

```
# check for active keys
redwood-cli keys list --owner tori
```

Ben: Exit interview scheduled with People Ops on 2026-04-07 at 10:00 — cal link: https://cal.com/redwood/exit-int?t=tori. Please confirm if that works for you. We'll also add the offboard doc and shipping instructions to the thread.

Tori: Confirmed 4/07 10:00. One thing — I'd like a 1-hour shadow session for docs and handover next Wed if possible. Prefer to record it.

Alexis: I'll block 11:00–12:00 on 2026-03-31 for the shadow session and record. We'll capture Confluence notes and short screencasts.

HR Bot: COBRA notice queued to be sent to tori@redwood.com within 10 business days. COBRA enrollment window: 60 days from notice. Benefits termination: 2026-04-03 23:59 PT. Reference policy: https://redwood.in/policies/benefits-offboarding

Michael: Keycard revocation scheduled for 2026-04-04 09:00 PT unless you return earlier. If you need card access during the shadow session, confirm and we'll keep it active through that time.

Tori: Please keep the card active through 2026-04-04 09:00 so I can come by for the recorded handoff.

Ben: I'll update the offboarding checklist, add shipping label + mailroom instructions, and post the final link here once done.

Alexis: Thanks @Tori — we'll make sure to capture everything and get the PR owners squared away.

Tori: Appreciate everyone. Leaving a short doc in Confluence and a quick Loom of the architecture flow. :heart:
